name: STT_Benchmark
description: STT_Benchmark is a dataset intended to evaluate automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems by providing audio clips paired with reference transcriptions across varied conditions. It measures transcription quality under different speakers, recording conditions, and noise types to compare robustness of ASR models. The benchmark supports standardized evaluation of models on common metrics and facilitates reproducible comparisons.
reputation: A small, community-contributed ASR benchmark on Hugging Face with modest adoption for model comparison and testing.
